notes.title: Build 936
notes.content:
We're sorry for being away for a very long time. Many people started to think that the game got abandoned, but that's not true!

It's a small update today, but more to come soon.

- No more "Invalid wear!" crash

- SteamCloud support

- Fixed memory leaks in ground physics, slightly better stability

- Proper names for all opponents

- Replaced some background mp3's

It also includes a workaround for the "falling through the ground" issue. If you're falling down even after this update, let us know in the comments, but pay attention to the build date on the top of your game window, it must say "Sep 17 2018". Many thanks to Adrian 'Silent' Zdanowicz for working very hard on that issue!

There's a one more thing again. Stay tuned!

notes.content:

3. "Delete": delete items

4. "Info": list your published items

You can read an updated documentation for this utility [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787893247]HERE[/url]

And this update also includes the new build 935 with few minor improvements:

 - No more "MSVCP140.dll" errors on Windows 7

 - Less memory leaks in resource engine, better stability

 - Game could move you to the garage after exiting freeride mode

 - Cheats and inputs will work if your default keyboard layout is not english

 - No more corrupted images in screenshots folder

 - Vehicles could suddenly fall through the ground in the city, that must not happen now

notes.title: Build 933
notes.content:
An another update is here:

3. Fast legacy build (run legacy executable if you have extremely low framerates)

Updates may come out less frequently, since we're working very hard on moving the game to the new game engine and preparing to release remakes of 9 original Street Legal Redline cars.

notes.title: Build 930
notes.content:
The new build 930 is here.

 - More smooth and realistic acceleration of all cars

 - Fixed critical bug that was resulting in an unrealistic internal damage

 - Vehicle in the garage could return into default position when pressing "Test engine and steering" button

 - Bots in night drag races now stop their cars if player finishes first, so they shouldn't rush into the back on finish line

 - More traffic/pedestrians in rush hours and on business days

 - Car could get stuck while attempting to drive in the garage

 - Red Flames garage now got the second car standing nearby

 - Duhen SunStrip 2.2DVC was equipped with an incorrect exhaust pipe

 - Fixed critical script errors in the code of all stock cars

 - All models of Einvagen Codrac, Einvagen Teg, Duhen Axis, PFAA Naxas, Shimutshibu ST9, MCA Stallion and Hauler's Furrano have incorrect wheels

 - Fixed incorrect wheel positions for all Einvagen Codrac, Duhen Axis, MCA Kurumma, Duhen Ninja, PFAA Naxas, Einvagen Remo, Einvagen Teg, Shimutshibu ST9, MCA Stallion, Shimutshibu Sunset, Baiern Yotta and Hauler's Furrano models

 - Fix errors in wheel kit scripts that may lead to random crashes in the game

 - Fixed chassis tilt for all Hauler's Badge models

 - Partial refactoring of Chassis.class, better implementation of detecting police siren on the car, removed useless imports

 - Einvagen Remo could come equipped with an incompletely assembled engine

 - Einvagen Teg has too many slots for N2O canisters

 - Added more slots for N2O canisters on Ishima Zed

We had to replace a lot of files once again, so if the game will crash after this update, delete all files in your game folder, reinstall it in Steam and start new career.

1. Delete all old careers and start new one;
2. If the game won't start or if it shows "Create hw 3d device FAILED", uninstall it from Steam (right-click on the game, select "Delete local content", then go to game folder and delete ALL files from there, install the game again)

If you want to enable cheats, to the following:

1. Go to your game folder (usually located at Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Street Legal Racing Redline v2.3.1)
2. Open file Player.java in sl\scripts\game\src\
3. Look for these lines of code:

[code]
int		c_enabled	= 0; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 0; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 0; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 0; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 0; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 0; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Replace with these:

/code]
int		c_enabled	= 1; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 1; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 1; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 1; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 1; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 1; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Save this file, run the game again, START NEW CAREER and save it.

notes.title: Cheats are now available
notes.content:
By many requests, we have unlocked the cheats, you don't need to complete career mode now since it's quite difficult to do with all these random crashes and weird bugs.

IMPORTANT: go to Extras -> Hidden options and check if everything is enabled there. You can disable auto save if you're scared that game will corrupt your savegame file after another crash.

Here's the description of all hidden options:

GARAGE CODES:
Special codes that you type in garage
 - testme (get any car, sometimes crashes when you call it, be careful!)
 - letmeroc (go to ROC immediately)
 - reddevil (go to the red club with 1st position in rating)
 - begformoney (adds $100K of cash)

To use garage codes, just type one of them while being in garage, then click screwdriver button. If nothing happened, the code didn't work.

TRACK CHEATS:
Hotkeys that give you advantages on track or in the city. Keys list:
 - F9 (flying camera for screenshots, use PgUp, PgDown, A, Z, Num+, Num- to control it)
 - Num0 (freeze time)
 - Enter (bullet time, slowmotion)
 - 1 (repair car)
 - 2 (reset car, stop it immediately)

EVENT LIST CHEATS:
Go to Event List menu, select racing event and press R key to bypass requirements and join the event.

KITS IN CATALOG:
Enables engine kits, body kits and suspension kits in catalog. Use these kits to build the cars quickly.

AUTO SAVING:
As it says, this controls automatic career saving in the game.

GHOST DRIVER:
A bit buggy feature. It removes driver from your car to let you make screenshots without him.

Click SAVE to save your settings in hidden options menu.
